mica_dev: Heads-up — preview estimates jumped ~2x for some embedding tenants after we enabled adaptive sampling last night. Suspect sample_weight applied twice + retry dupes.

ana_sre: Confirmed in logs. Many events with different request_id but headers.x-client-retry-of=null. Older SDKs reissue ids on retry.

phil_billing: That breaks dedupe. Ledger uses request_id. Two short-term options: require SDKs to set x-client-retry-of OR add server-side fingerprint fallback.

courtney_prod: SDK change will be slow. Fingerprint fallback seems pragmatic but UX must show provenance. Customers want to know "why did preview differ?"

mica_dev: Fingerprint proposal: sha1(tenant_id|model|trunc(prompt_sha256,16)). We'll attach fingerprint to raw event when available. Use COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) as dedupe_key.

ana_sre: Cost caveat: hashing every event on hot path is expensive. Suggest compute fingerprint sync only for tokens>500 or tenants with flag `metering_fingerprint=true`. Otherwise async enrich and mark dedupe_basis=pending.

phil_billing: Ledger can accept dedupe_basis values (request_id|x-client-retry-of|fingerprint|pending). We'll require aggregators to emit it so invoices carry provenance.

ingest-bot: deploy queued: canary/metering-shim v2.1 -> staging (owner: mica_dev) :rocket:

courtney_prod: Rollout plan: 1) canary to 3 tenants at 5% traffic, 2) monitor metric `metering.preview_estimate_ratio{route="embeddings"}`, alert if >1.25 for 15m, 3) abort and rollback if >1.3.

mica_dev: I'll add `x-metering-debug=true` for canary to echo dedupe_basis in raw events to speed verification.

phil_billing: Quick SQL sketch for aggregator with fallback (pseudo): SELECT COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) AS dedupe_key, SUM(tokens)*(1.0/NULLIF(sample_rate,1.0)) AS est_tokens FROM raw_metering GROUP BY dedupe_key;

ana_sre: I'll own dashboards and runbook. Post canary report in thread.

mica_dev: Thanks — RFC will be up and linked. :thumbsup:
